title: 谈判策略
subtitle: 在价格、交期和付款条件之间协商

questions.instruction: 谈判中的 concession 是什么意思？
options: 让步
承诺
异议
条件

questions.prompt: The discount will be approved only if the order is placed before Friday.
questions.audio: The discount will be approved only if the order is placed before Friday.
questions.answer: 只有在周五之前下单，折扣才会获批。
options: 只有在周五之前下单，折扣才会获批。
只要折扣在周五之前获批，订单就能取消。
只有在周五之后下单，折扣才会获批。
即使周五之前没有下单，折扣也已获批。
questions.translation: 只有在周五之前下单，折扣才会获批。

questions.prompt: 听采购经理说明报价包含哪些费用。
questions.instruction: 留意 included 和 charged separately。
questions.audio: Delivery is included, but installation will be charged separately.
questions.answer: 报价包含送货，但安装另收费。
options: 报价包含送货，但安装另收费。
报价包含安装，但送货另收费。
送货和安装都包含在报价中。
送货和安装都需要另付费用。
questions.translation: 报价包含送货，但安装另收费。

questions.prompt: 在我们接受还价方案之前，付款条件必须得到确认。
questions.answer: Payment terms must be confirmed before we accept the counteroffer.
questions.audio: Payment terms must be confirmed before we accept the counteroffer.
questions.translation: 在我们接受还价方案之前，付款条件必须得到确认。

questions.prompt: The revised quote _____ to our purchasing team yesterday.
questions.instruction: 选择符合时间和主语的形式。
options: was sent
is sent
has sent
was sending
questions.audio: The revised quote was sent to our purchasing team yesterday.
questions.translation: 修改后的报价昨天已发给我们的采购团队。

questions.prompt: 配对报价协商中的术语。
questions.translation: 让步；还价方案；订金；付款条件；送货费；批量订单

questions.instruction: 收到报价后提出的 counteroffer 是什么？
options: 还价方案
原始报价
最终账单
付款凭证

questions.prompt: We were offered a lower price in exchange for a larger deposit.
questions.instruction: 对方提出的交换条件是什么？
questions.answer: 提高订金可以换取更低的价格。
options: 提高订金可以换取更低的价格。
减少订金可以换取更低的价格。
提高订金可以换取更早的交期。
减少订单数量可以换取更高的订金。
questions.audio: We were offered a lower price in exchange for a larger deposit.
questions.translation: 对方提出，只要我们支付更高的订金，就能获得更低的价格。

questions.prompt: 听双方确认让步是否已经生效。
questions.instruction: 留意建议和正式批准的区别。
questions.audio: The concession has been discussed, but it hasn't been approved by the director yet.
questions.answer: 双方讨论过这项让步，但主管尚未批准。
options: 双方讨论过这项让步，但主管尚未批准。
主管批准了这项让步，但双方尚未讨论。
主管拒绝了这项让步，并要求终止讨论。
双方已经批准这项让步，只是还没通知主管。
questions.translation: 双方讨论过这项让步，但主管尚未批准。

questions.prompt: No changes can _____ once both parties have signed.
options: be made
have made
making
made
questions.audio: No changes can be made once both parties have signed.
questions.translation: 双方签字后便不能再作修改。

dialogue.scene: 协商会议室桌椅的采购报价

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: The price is within our budget, but can delivery be brought forward to the tenth?
turns.translation: 价格在我们的预算内，但送货能提前到十号吗？

turns.speaker: supplier
turns.text: Only half the order can be delivered by then. The rest would arrive a week later.
turns.translation: 到那时只能交付一半订单，其余部分要晚一周到。

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: That would work if we're only charged for delivery once.
turns.translation: 如果只收一次送货费，那可以。

turns.speaker: supplier
turns.text: Agreed. I'll put both delivery dates and the single charge in the revised quote.
turns.translation: 没问题。我会在修改后的报价里写明两个送货日期，并注明只收一次费用。

tasks.prompt: What arrangement do they agree on?
tasks.answer: Two deliveries with one delivery charge
options: Two deliveries with one delivery charge
One delivery with an extra charge
Two deliveries, each charged separately
One delivery a week after the tenth
